Which expert system and synonym layer produced a result

Source: R/resy_provenance.R
resy_provenance.Rd

Reports the expert-system release a parsed expert system or a classification result rests on, so it can be stored next to the result or cited: the scheme and version, the file that was read, the MD5 checksum of its content, the DOI of the published release, and whether the file is byte-identical to the published .txt. For a result of resy_classify() with resolve_taxa = TRUE and the bundled synonym layer, the build date of that layer and the taxify version it was built with are added.

Usage

resy_provenance(x)

Arguments

x

A resy_parsed_expert from resy_load_expert() or a resy_result from resy_classify().

Value

A one-row data frame with columns scheme, version, expert_file, expert_md5, release_doi, identical_to_release, synonym_layer_built, synonym_layer_taxify and resy_version. identical_to_release is NA when no published release of that scheme and version is known (for example a user's own system); the synonym_layer_* columns are NA when no synonym layer was used.

See also

resy_load_expert(), resy_classify()

Examples

resy_provenance(resy_load_expert(scheme = "EUNIS", version = "2021-06-01"))
#>   scheme    version   expert_file                       expert_md5
#> 1  EUNIS 2021-06-01 expert.txt.xz 775ea4542b1ef7a7ea23e9f1dac01bc6
#>              release_doi identical_to_release synonym_layer_built
#> 1 10.5281/zenodo.4812736                 TRUE                <NA>
#>   synonym_layer_taxify resy_version
#> 1                 <NA>          0.3
